extDescription.message: Blocks ads and trackers. No account, no analytics.

popupCaptionEmpty.message: Nothing to block on this page yet

popupCaptionOff.message: Nothing is blocked on this site

updateFiltersHintBundled.message: Download your custom lists again. Built-in lists update with PrivaBlock itself.

profileHint.message: A profile picks a set of filter lists. Balanced suits everyday browsing.

profile_light_hint.message: Fewer rules, for older or slower computers

profile_strict_hint.message: Also annoyances and cookie notices; some sites may break

listsHint.message: Lists are downloaded from their publishers and refreshed every day. More lists catch more, but use more memory and break more sites.

listsHintBundled.message: Lists are built into PrivaBlock and update with it. More lists catch more, but break more sites.

manyLists.message: Many lists are on. That uses more memory and can break sites; Balanced is usually enough.

staticLimit.message: The browser refused to turn on all selected lists (its rule limit is shared by all extensions). Turn some lists off.

customHint.message: Subscribe to any public Adblock-compatible list by its address.

myFiltersHint.message: One rule per line, in Adblock syntax. Cosmetic rules look like example.com##.advertisement.

dynamicLimit.message: The browser allows at most $1 rules from your filters and custom lists; $2 were left out.

fingerprintHint.message: Turns on Firefox's own fingerprinting resistance. Sites see the UTC time zone and a light theme, and some break. Turning it off gives Firefox's setting back.

disabledHint.message: Turn protection off for a site from the PrivaBlock button while you're on it.

diagnosticsHint.message: The logger, opened from the PrivaBlock button, shows every request of a tab and the filter that decided it.

diagnosticsHintChromium.message: The logger, opened from the PrivaBlock button, shows the blocked requests of a tab and which list blocked them.

backgroundUnavailable.message: PrivaBlock isn't responding. Reload the extension.

loggerEmpty.message: Nothing yet. Reload the page to see its requests.

loggerNoTarget.message: Open the logger from the PrivaBlock button while viewing a site.

loggerNote.message: Requests are recorded only while this page is open.

loggerNoteChromium.message: Chromium reports which list blocked a request, not its address. Press Refresh to load new matches.

badgeHint.message: The number of requests blocked on the page appears on the toolbar icon
